gloss: margin (of a page); outside a column or field

definitions.gloss: margin (of a page); outside a column or field
definitions.explanation: The space outside the main text area on a page, form, or document. Used for marginal notes, annotations, or references.

examples.english: Write a note in the margin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注釈|ちゅうしゃく}→注釈：09766_chuushaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{欄外|らんがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The annotations are printed in the margin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申請書|しんせいしょ}→申請書：07486_shinseisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{欄外|らんがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{補足|ほそく}→補足：08386_hosoku⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}えた→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: I added a supplementary note in the margin of the application form.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ (column, field, section) and ⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside). Refers to any space outside the designated text area or form fields on a printed page or document.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {欄外|らんがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to write in the margin
- {欄外|らんがい}{注|ちゅう}: marginal note, footnote
- {欄外|らんがい}⟦{参照|さんしょう}→参照：11866_sanshou⟧: marginal reference
- {欄外|らんがい}⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧: margin note

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{余白|よはく}→余白：06838_yohaku⟧: blank space, margin — refers to the white/empty space itself, whereas {欄外|らんがい} emphasizes being "outside the designated area"
- ⟦{脚注|きゃくちゅう}→脚注：06423_kyakuchuu⟧: footnote — a specific type of annotation at the bottom of a page
- ⟦{注釈|ちゅうしゃく}→注釈：09766_chuushaku⟧: annotation, commentary — the content of notes, regardless of where they appear
